I am an old woman, 58 years, and I farm this small piece of land near my house to feed my family. I plant yam and cassava together with small vegetables, the way my mother taught me. I have no money to buy the expensive chemical fertilizer from town, so I use the droppings from my goats and chickens, and the ash from my cooking fire. The rain comes when God sends it, and my children help me when school is closed.
